name: billboard
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 front-on architectural photograph of a premium outdoor billboard set into a warm limestone wall in a Baja creative district. Perfectly rectangular large blank warm ivory billboard face with straight horizontal/vertical edges, occupying center 80% of width and 65% of height. Thin dark metal border. Terracotta stucco accents, subtle cactus shadow on surrounding wall only, clear late afternoon side sunlight, cropped natural rough stone pavement below. No people, no text, no logos, no letters, no symbols anywhere. No perspective skew on sign. Editorial tactile physical photography, muted cream/clay palette. The blank flat sign will receive actual brand typography later.

name: hoodie
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 editorial studio photograph cropped from chin to waist of a fictional adult wearing a premium plain unbranded warm ivory heavyweight cotton hoodie. Front facing, centered torso, chest facing camera directly, broad smooth blank chest area across upper center, no hands across chest. Natural drape and detailed cotton texture, subtle folds away from center. Warm limestone background with a diffuse cactus shadow, soft directional daylight, premium understated merchandise art direction. NO logo, NO text, NO graphics, NO jewelry, NO lettering, NO print. No visible face needed. Garment front stays neutral ivory; entire image warm and tactile, no shiny fabric.
